$comment: Seed data for the state-machine kernel (lib/states.js). Becomes the stateMachines registry list on first boot and is edited in the console from then on. states/transitions may reference a registry list as list:<name>. Tags are what a state MEANS to the engines (they ask by tag, never by name); stamps are time columns written on entering a state; 'on' declares per-move guards and effects: set, stamp, run <handler>, guard <handler>.
